alerts.name: ClickHouse Categraf 副本进入只读
alerts.action:
1) 执行 SELECT database, table, is_readonly, zookeeper_exception FROM system.replicas WHERE is_readonly 定位只读的表和原因；
2) 检查 ZooKeeper/Keeper 集群是否健康（echo ruok | nc <zk> 2181），以及 ClickHouse 到它的网络连通性；
3) ZK 恢复后执行 SYSTEM RESTART REPLICA <db>.<table> 让副本重新建立会话；
4) 若是 ZK 上元数据丢失，需要 SYSTEM RESTORE REPLICA 重建，操作前先确认另有健康副本。

alerts.name: ClickHouse Categraf 内存使用
alerts.action:
1) 执行 SELECT query, memory_usage, elapsed FROM system.processes ORDER BY memory_usage DESC LIMIT 5 找当前吃内存的查询，必要时 KILL QUERY WHERE query_id='...' 止血；
2) 查 system.query_log 里 memory_usage 最高的历史查询，定位缺少过滤条件或大 JOIN 的 SQL；
3) 用 max_memory_usage / max_bytes_before_external_group_by 给单查询设上限并允许落盘；
4) 确认 mark cache、uncompressed cache 配置是否过大。

alerts.name: ClickHouse Categraf 磁盘使用
alerts.action:
1) 执行 SELECT name, free_space, total_space FROM system.disks 确认各磁盘水位；
2) 用 SELECT database, table, formatReadableSize(sum(bytes)) FROM system.parts WHERE active GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY sum(bytes) DESC 找出占用最大的表；
3) 对有 TTL 的表执行 ALTER TABLE ... MATERIALIZE TTL 触发清理，或直接 DROP PARTITION 删除过期分区；
4) 长期需扩容磁盘或配置多卷存储策略把冷数据下沉。

alerts.name: ClickHouse Categraf 并发网络连接数过高
alerts.name_en: ClickHouse Categraf concurrent network connections too high
alerts.action:
1) 执行 SELECT count(), user, client_hostname FROM system.processes GROUP BY 2,3 ORDER BY 1 DESC 看连接来自哪些客户端；
2) 对照 system.metrics 里的 Query、TCPConnection 判断是查询并发高还是连接泄漏；
3) 客户端未复用连接的，在应用侧改用连接池；
4) 确认 max_concurrent_queries 与 max_connections 配置是否与实例规格匹配，必要时限流。

alerts.name: ClickHouse 原生端点 认证错误
alerts.action:
1) 查 SELECT event_time, user, client_hostname, exception FROM system.query_log WHERE type='ExceptionBeforeStart' AND exception LIKE '%AUTHENTICATION_FAILED%' ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 20 定位来源 IP 与用户名；
2) 来源是自家应用则核对配置里的账号密码与 users.xml；
3) 来源陌生 IP 则按入侵尝试处理，收紧 users.xml 的 networks 白名单并改密码；
4) 确认 ClickHouse 端口没有直接暴露在公网。

alerts.name: ClickHouse 原生端点 副本进入只读
alerts.name_en: ClickHouse native endpoint replica is read-only
alerts.action:
1) 执行 SELECT database, table, is_readonly, zookeeper_exception FROM system.replicas WHERE is_readonly 定位只读的表和原因；
2) 检查 ZooKeeper/Keeper 集群是否健康（echo ruok | nc <zk> 2181），以及 ClickHouse 到它的网络连通性；
3) ZK 恢复后执行 SYSTEM RESTART REPLICA <db>.<table> 让副本重新建立会话；
4) 若是 ZK 上元数据丢失，需要 SYSTEM RESTORE REPLICA 重建，操作前先确认另有健康副本。

2) 查 system.query_log 里 memory_usage 最高的历史查询，定位缺少过滤条件或大 JOIN 的 SQL；

alerts.name: ClickHouse 原生端点 副本错误
alerts.action:
1) 执行 SELECT database, table, is_readonly, absolute_delay, zookeeper_exception FROM system.replicas 定位失效的表；
2) absolute_delay 很大说明副本追不上，检查副本节点的 IO 与 merge 队列（system.replication_queue）；
3) ALL_REPLICAS_LOST 通常是 ZooKeeper 上的元数据丢失，需要在健康副本上确认数据后执行 SYSTEM RESTORE REPLICA；
4) 恢复期间把查询路由到健康分片，避免持续报错。

metrics.name: MergeTree表插入的未压缩字节数
metrics.name_en: Number of uncompressed bytes inserted by the MergeTree table
metrics.note:
插入到MergeTree表的未压缩字节数（列以它们在内存中存储的形式）

在ClickHouse数据库中，当数据被插入到MergeTree系列表（包括ReplicatedMergeTree等）时，在数据实际被写入磁盘并经过压缩处理之前，在内存中以原始格式暂存时所占用的字节数量。这里的“未压缩”意味着数据还未经过ClickHouse为了节省存储空间而在存储阶段执行的列式存储压缩算法处理
metrics.note_en:
Number of uncompressed bytes inserted into the MergeTree table (columns in the form they are stored in memory) 
 
In a ClickHouse database, when data is inserted into a MergeTree series table (including ReplicatedMergeTree, etc.), the number of bytes occupied when it is temporarily stored in the original format in memory before the data is actually written to disk and compressed. "Uncompressed" here means that the data has not been processed by the columnar storage compression algorithm that ClickHouse executes during the storage phase to save storage space

collect.content:
# # collect interval
# interval = 15

# Read metrics from one or many ClickHouse servers
[[instances]]
  ## Username for authorization on ClickHouse server
  username = "default"

  ## Password for authorization on ClickHouse server
  # password = ""

  ## HTTP(s) timeout while getting metrics values
  ## The timeout includes connection time, any redirects, and reading the
  ## response body.
  # timeout = 5

  ## List of servers for metrics scraping
  ## metrics scrape via HTTP(s) clickhouse interface
  ## https://clickhouse.tech/docs/en/interfaces/http/
  # servers = ["http://127.0.0.1:8123"]

  ## If "auto_discovery"" is "true" plugin tries to connect to all servers
  ## available in the cluster with using same "user:password" described in
  ## "user" and "password" parameters and get this server hostname list from
  ## "system.clusters" table. See
  ## - https://clickhouse.tech/docs/en/operations/system_tables/#system-clusters
  ## - https://clickhouse.tech/docs/en/operations/server_settings/settings/#server_settings_remote_servers
  ## - https://clickhouse.tech/docs/en/operations/table_engines/distributed/
  ## - https://clickhouse.tech/docs/en/operations/table_engines/replication/#creating-replicated-tables
  # auto_discovery = true

  ## Filter cluster names in "system.clusters" when "auto_discovery" is "true"
  ## when this filter present then "WHERE cluster IN (...)" filter will apply
  ## please use only full cluster names here, regexp and glob filters is not
  ## allowed for "/etc/clickhouse-server/config.d/remote.xml"
  ## <yandex>
  ##  <remote_servers>
  ##    <my-own-cluster>
  ##        <shard>
  ##          <replica><host>clickhouse-ru-1.local</host><port>9000</port></replica>
  ##          <replica><host>clickhouse-ru-2.local</host><port>9000</port></replica>
  ##        </shard>
  ##        <shard>
  ##          <replica><host>clickhouse-eu-1.local</host><port>9000</port></replica>
  ##          <replica><host>clickhouse-eu-2.local</host><port>9000</port></replica>
  ##        </shard>
  ##    </my-own-cluster>
  ##  </remote_servers>
  ##
  ## </yandex>
  ##
  ## example: cluster_include = ["my-own-cluster"]
  # cluster_include = []

  ## Filter cluster names in "system.clusters" when "auto_discovery" is
  ## "true" when this filter present then "WHERE cluster NOT IN (...)"
  ## filter will apply
  ##    example: cluster_exclude = ["my-internal-not-discovered-cluster"]
  # cluster_exclude = []
